slots.sentence: My usual lens is around 28-35 mm, but these longer ones are used to photograph sporting events — or in this case, a celestial event.

slots.sentence: As totality took effect, I turned to look upward during the one minute and 45 seconds in which the event could be safely viewed with the naked eye (and with a camera lacking a solar lens).

slots.sentence: On Wednesday, about 980 million people across parts of the Northern Hemisphere will have the chance to observe this upcoming solar eclipse .

slots.name: totality duration
slots.sentence: About two hours later, at 17:46 GMT, the eclipse will reach totality for about two minutes.
